segments.zh: 记住使用减压阀、CGA 接头和泄压装置的规则，以及它们的工作原理。

segments.text: Know the procedures you should follow to hook cylinders into gas systems correctly
segments.zh: 了解把气瓶正确接入供气系统应遵循的程序，

segments.text: and be prepared to deal with a gas leak or other gas-related emergency.
segments.zh: 并做好应对气体泄漏或其他与气体有关的紧急情况的准备。

segments.text: Most accidents involving compressed gases should never happen. With some preparation and foresight,
segments.zh: 大多数涉及压缩气体的事故本不应该发生。只要做些准备、有些远见，

segments.text: you can keep the gases that you use under control and your lab safe and incident-free.
segments.zh: 你就能让所用的气体处于控制之下，让你的实验室安全、无事故。
